title: Ordered vector-purity direct-sum equation
statement: For the normalized family of [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization] and pullback comparisons of [def-pur-vector-purity-base-change], define ordered direct-sum compatibility. Given F,G of ranks r,s over B, use h:E(F⊕G)→B, p:E(G)→B, q:E(F⊕G)→E(G), j:E(F⊕G)→E(F) induced by the two inclusions into F⊕G. Retain q≫p=h and the Cartesian square (j,q,pi_F,p), together with actual compactifications c of p and e of q≫c.i. Let c_upper:Rh^!≈Rp^!Rq^! be the right-adjoint mate of the compact-support compositor formed through this triangle. Form gamma_q by base change of gamma_F at the coefficient-unit object followed by the canonical dualizing tensor map. Separately normalize gamma_G and gamma_(F⊕G) by integration. On every bounded constructible finite-Tor K, require gamma_h,K=a_(r,s),K≫(1 tensor q^*gamma_p,K)≫gamma_q,Rp^!K≫c_upper,K^{-1}, with a built from the ordered Tate-power associator and pullback tensor/composition comparisons. The rank and compactification/quasi-compactness witnesses are asserted, not extra hypotheses on F,G. The equation is required for every choice of the ambient compactification instances and every compactification triangle (c,e).
